GTA VI now occupies the top three spots on the PS5 preorder chart

The Ultimate Edition upgrade has climbed to third

The GTA 6 TV spot has aired on Brazil’s biggest TV network, Globo and SporTV.

It also aired in more countries including:

- Mexico’s Channel 5
- Poland’s Eleven channels
- Saudi Arabia’s beIN Sports
- Argentina’s ESPN
- USA’s NBC TV and Sky Sports
- Canada’s Sportsnet

Cara Delevingne, the real voice behind the iconic GTA 5 Non-Stop-Pop host is excited for GTA 6 and she even took time off to play it:

“I love that game, I always will. I booked out 2 weeks after the game comes out, I can’t wait. It’s gonna be incredible.”
Ex-Rockstar technical director believes AI ports could push GTA 6 to PC sooner

Rockstar has sponsored Nick DiGiovanni’s new video, featuring the Prairie sandwich from GTA 6, which is the in-game version of Arby’s Meat Mountain containing 30,000 calories.

They also previously sponsored other creators, including Druski’s Coulda Been Records and Kenny
